result.whyNotTheCap: The parcel is a triangle ~414 ft deep at most. A 145-ft frontage tier + 60-ft R/W + 120-ft tiers both sides of a new street needs ~445 ft, so the new street serves conforming lots on one side only. 1,060 street geometries (station, stem, turn −90…+90°, length) were searched; 14 conforming 9,500-sf/75-ft lots is the most any of them fits. Reaching 19–20 would need smaller lots than RSF-95 allows, a second street, or terms of SE-1796 not read here.
